# Phylogeny of cif genes
## Extract fasta for Cif A and B
```{r, eval=TRUE}

### Reference
ref_seq <- readDNAStringSet(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "assembly_China", "wSuz_RW2025a.fasta"))
# Check reference name and length
names(ref_seq)
width(ref_seq)

## Positions
gene.position <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "wSuz_genes_BLAST_hits.txt"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
head(gene.position)
cifAB_data <- gene.position[gene.position$gene_name2 == "cifA"|gene.position$gene_name2 == "cifB", ]

cifAB_seq <- DNAStringSet(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(cifAB_data)), extract_cif_genes, gene=cifAB_data, ref=ref_seq))

## Name of the sequences
names(cifAB_seq) <- cifAB_data$gene

writeXStringSet(
  cifAB_seq,
  file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data",
    "wSuz_typeI&II_cifAB.fasta"
  )
)


## The two copies in WRI are identical
cifAB_seq[["TypeI_cifA_1"]] ==
cifAB_seq[["TypeI_cifA_2"]]
cifAB_seq[["TypeI_cifA_1"]] ==
cifAB_seq[["TypeI_cifA_3"]]

```

## Load cif data
```{r, eval=TRUE}

data <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "cif_data", "Table S2_Cif homologs summary.xlsx"), sheet = "Table S2", skip=1)
data
data |>
    dplyr::filter(`Wolbachia strain`=="wSuz")|>
  dplyr::select("cifA...15", "cifB...16")

## Extract rows for wRi and wMel
cifAB_wRI_wMel <- data |>
  dplyr::filter(`Wolbachia strain` %in% c("wRi", "wMel", "wSpc", "wPipPel")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    strain = `Wolbachia strain`
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(strain, Type) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    copy = dplyr::row_number()
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

## Export cif A and cif B
seqs <- cifAB_wRI_wMel |>
  dplyr::pull(`cifA...15`) |>
  gsub(pattern = "\\s+", replacement = "")

seqs <- DNAStringSet(seqs)

names(seqs) <- paste0(
  cifAB_wRI_wMel$strain, "_Type",cifAB_wRI_wMel$Type,
  "_cifA_",
  cifAB_wRI_wMel$copy
)


## The two copies in WRI are identical
seqs[["wRi_TypeI_cifA_1"]] ==
seqs[["wRi_TypeI_cifA_2"]]


writeXStringSet(
  seqs,
  file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data",
    "wRI_wMel_cifA.fasta"
  )
)


## Export Cif B
seqs <- cifAB_wRI_wMel |>
  dplyr::pull(`cifB...16`) |>
  gsub(pattern = "\\s+", replacement = "")

seqs <- DNAStringSet(seqs)

names(seqs) <- paste0(
  cifAB_wRI_wMel$strain, "_Type",cifAB_wRI_wMel$Type,
  "_cifB_",
  cifAB_wRI_wMel$copy
)

writeXStringSet(
  seqs,
  file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data",
    "wRI_wMel_cifB.fasta"
  )
)

## The two copies in WRI are identical
seqs[["wRi_TypeI_cifB_1"]] ==
seqs[["wRi_TypeI_cifB_2"]]
```

## Step 1: Prepare sequences for alignment
```{r, eval=TRUE}
#dir.create(file.path(
#    here::here(),
#    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree"))
# Load FASTA files
wSuz <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data",
    "wSuz_typeI&II_cifAB.fasta"
  ))

## Trim the first two nucleotides of TypeII_cifA_2 so that the nucleotide sequence is in frame for translation
wSuz["TypeII_cifA_2"] <- subseq(
  wSuz["TypeII_cifA_2"],
  start = 3
)

wRi_wMel_cifA  <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data",
    "wRI_wMel_cifA.fasta"
  ))
wRi_wMel_cifB  <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data",
    "wRI_wMel_cifB.fasta"
  ))

# Use only Type I cifA
#wSuz <- wSuz[grepl("TypeI_cifA", names(wSuz), ignore.case = TRUE)]
#wRi_wMel <- wRi_wMel[grepl("TypeI_cifA", names(wRi_wMel), ignore.case = TRUE)]
#wSuz <- wSuz[grepl("cifA", names(wSuz), ignore.case = TRUE)&!grepl("TypeII_cifA_1", names(wSuz), ignore.case = TRUE)]
#names(wSuz) <- paste("wSuz", names(wSuz), sep="_")

# Use only cifA
wSuz_cifA <- wSuz[grepl("cifA", names(wSuz))&!grepl("TypeII_cifA_1", names(wSuz))]
names(wSuz_cifA) <- paste("wSuz", names(wSuz_cifA), sep="_")
wSuz_cifB <- wSuz[grepl("cifB", names(wSuz))]
names(wSuz_cifB) <- paste("wSuz", names(wSuz_cifB), sep="_")

# Combine sequences
seqs_cifA <- c(wSuz_cifA[grepl("TypeI_", names(wSuz_cifA))], wRi_wMel_cifA, wSuz_cifA[grepl("TypeII_", names(wSuz_cifA))])
names(seqs_cifA)
seqs_cifB <- c(wSuz_cifB[grepl("TypeI_", names(wSuz_cifB))], wRi_wMel_cifB, wSuz_cifB[grepl("TypeII_", names(wSuz_cifB))])

names(seqs_cifA)[!grepl("wSuz_TypeI_|wRi_TypeI_", names(seqs_cifA))] <- gsub("_1|_2|_3", "", names(seqs_cifA)[!grepl("wSuz_TypeI_|wRi_TypeI_", names(seqs_cifA))] )
names(seqs_cifB)[!grepl("wSuz_TypeI_|wRi_TypeI_", names(seqs_cifB))] <- gsub("_1|_2|_3", "", names(seqs_cifB)[!grepl("wSuz_TypeI_|wRi_TypeI_", names(seqs_cifB))] )

names(seqs_cifA)
names(seqs_cifB)

# Devide by three
Biostrings::width(seqs_cifA) %% 3
Biostrings::width(seqs_cifB) %% 3

## Translate into protein
prot_cifA <- Biostrings::translate(seqs_cifA)
prot_cifB <- Biostrings::translate(seqs_cifB)


Biostrings::writeXStringSet(
  prot_cifA,
  file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
    "prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifA.fasta"
  )
)
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(
  prot_cifB,
  file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
    "prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifB.fasta"
  )
)



```


## Step 2: Align, step 3: clean sequences and step 4: concatenate
```{r, eval=TRUE}
## Step 2: Align
## Input and output fasta file
in_cifA <- file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
    "prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifA.fasta"
  )
in_cifB <- file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
    "prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifB.fasta"
  )

out_cifA.fas <- file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
    "align_prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifA.fasta"
  )
out_cifB.fas <- file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
    "align_prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifB.fasta"
  )

## Perform alignement using mafft
system(
paste(
    "/usr/local/bin/mafft --auto",
    shQuote(in_cifA),
    ">",
    shQuote(out_cifA.fas)
  )
)

## Perform alignement using mafft
system(
paste(
    "/usr/local/bin/mafft --auto",
    shQuote(in_cifB),
    ">",
    shQuote(out_cifB.fas)
  )
)

## Step 3: clean sequences 
clean_align_cifA <- file.path(
  here::here(),
  "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
  "clean_align_prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifA.fasta"
)
clean_align_cifB <- file.path(
  here::here(),
  "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
  "clean_align_prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifB.fasta"
)
system2(
  "/opt/miniconda3/bin/clipkit",
  args = c(
    shQuote(out_cifA.fas),
    "-o", shQuote(clean_align_cifA)
  )
)
system2(
  "/opt/miniconda3/bin/clipkit",
  args = c(
    shQuote(out_cifB.fas),
    "-o", shQuote(clean_align_cifB)
  )
)

## Step 4: concatenate cifA and cifB sequences

# Load FASTA files
prot_cifA <- Biostrings::readAAStringSet(clean_align_cifA)
prot_cifB <- Biostrings::readAAStringSet(clean_align_cifB)


fasta.seqlengths(filepath=clean_align_cifA,
               nrec=-1L, skip=0L, seek.first.rec=FALSE,
               seqtype="B", use.names=TRUE)

fasta.seqlengths(filepath=clean_align_cifB,
               nrec=-1L, skip=0L, seek.first.rec=FALSE,
               seqtype="B", use.names=TRUE)

## Concatenate corresponding CifA + CifB proteins
prot_cifAB <- AAStringSet(
  paste0(
    as.character(prot_cifA),
    as.character(prot_cifB)
  )
)

## Keep the names
names(prot_cifAB) <- gsub("cifA", "cifAB", names(prot_cifA))

## Export contactenated sequences
output.fas <- file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
    "clean_align_prot_wSuz_wRI_wMel_cifAB.fasta"
  )
writeXStringSet(
  prot_cifAB,
  output.fas
)

fasta.seqlengths(filepath=output.fas,
               nrec=-1L, skip=0L, seek.first.rec=FALSE,
               seqtype="B", use.names=TRUE)


## Check alignement

cifA <- readAAStringSet(
  out_cifA.fas
)

cifB <- readAAStringSet(
  out_cifB.fas
)

p1 <- ggmsa(
  cifA,
  start = 300,
  #end = 200,
 end = width(cifA)[1],
  seq_name = TRUE,
  char_width = 0.7,
  color = "Clustal"
)+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 4.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 2.5),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )


p2 <-ggmsa(
  cifB,
  start = 300,
  end = 500,
 # end = width(cifB)[1],
  seq_name = TRUE,
  char_width = 0.7,
  color = "Clustal"
)+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 4.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 2.5),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

p1/p2
ggsave(file.path(here::here(), "plots", "Fig.SX_Aligment_CifAB.pdf"), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm")


```

## Step5: Make tree
```{r, eval=TRUE}

outdir <- file.path(
  here::here(),
  "data", "genomic_data", "fasta_for_tree",
  "iqtree"
)

## Call IDtree
#use ModelFinder (-m MFP) to select the substitution model;
#infer the maximum-likelihood tree;
#calculate 1,000 ultrafast bootstrap replicates (-bb 1000);
#calculate 1,000 SH-aLRT replicates (-alrt 1000);
# use 1 available CPU threads.

system2(
  "/opt/homebrew/bin/iqtree3",
  args = c(
    "-s", shQuote(output.fas),
    "-m", "MFP",
    "-bb", "1000",
    "-alrt", "1000",
    "-nt", "1",
    "-redo",
    "-pre", shQuote(file.path(outdir, "cifAB"))
  )
)

## Load tree
tree <- read.tree(
  file.path(outdir, "cifAB.treefile")
)
tree$tip.label

## Reroot tree
tree_rooted <- root(
  tree,
  outgroup = "wPipPel_TypeIV_cifAB",
  resolve.root = TRUE
)

library(ggtree)

p <- ggtree(tree_rooted, layout = "rectangular") +
  geom_tiplab(size = 3) +
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip,
      label = sub(".*/", "", label),
      #label = label
    ),
    size = 3,
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = -0.08,
    nudge_y = 0.15
  )
p  + xlim(0, max(p$data$x) + 0.3)


## Change position of bootstrap
p <- ggtree(
  tree_rooted,
  layout = "rectangular"
) +
  # All bootstrap values except nodes 18 and 22
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip & node !=22,
      label = sub("/.*", "", label)
    ),
    size = 3,
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = -0.04,
    nudge_y = 0.15
  ) +

  # Node 22: move down
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip & node == 22,
      label = sub("/.*", "", label)
    ),
    size = 3,
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = -0.04,
    nudge_y = -0.3
  ) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 2.5)

p + xlim(0, max(p$data$x) + 0.3)
ggsave(file.path(here::here(), "plots", "Fig.4C_cif_phylogeny.pdf"), width = 30, height = 10, units = "cm")


ggtree(tree_rooted)$data|>
print(n = 23)

p +
  # Type I (node 19)
  geom_rect(
    xmin = 0.75,
    xmax = 1.2,
    ymin = 4.5,
    ymax = 12.5,
    fill = "#FF339C",
    alpha = 0.02,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  
  # Type II
  geom_rect(
    xmin = 0.3,
    xmax = 1.1,
    ymin = 1.5,
    ymax = 4.5,
    fill = "#EF7C3A",
    alpha = 0.02,
    colour = NA
  )+
   # Type IV
  geom_rect(
  xmin = 1.1,
  xmax = 1.4,
  ymin = 0.5,
  ymax = 1.5,
  fill = "#90D254",
  alpha = 0.02,
  colour = NA
)
```
